name: STR8-N MON g8 / tools preview 1 - N-F 0.3.0 BASE1/PR05
body:
Optional STR8-N MON/tools preview for **STR8N-F v0.3.0 BASE1/PR05**. The frozen 4KB F image and existing v0.3.0 downloads are unchanged; v0.3.0 remains the latest stable foundation.

This preview supplies MON A/B 0.1.0-dev g00000008, services g4, WB2 g5 and PROGRAM/SP1. It adds Dump/Modify and guarded force writes, maps/wear, TIME/CLOCK, board-loaded MAINT, flash/PROGRAM Table/Store/AUTO/Restore, compatible APPS and bounded BATCH. **The Python serial terminal, manual, source and checksums are included.**

Hardware scope: installed MON B and services g4 passed on 2609, WDC W65C816SXB in emulation mode with FT245 and matching EDU peripherals. Earlier W65C02SXB/EDU monitor and positive PROGRAM/APPS RAM evidence is retained. New services g4 on 65C02 and positive 816 PROGRAM writes/run or owner-app launch are not claimed. Full SOURCE/ASM/DEBUG, full BATCH parity and advanced CLOCK/FLASH/CONFIG remain unfinished.

On the qualified 2609, default S/recovery is preserved: at REC>, type **B** and Enter to start MON B; **Q** returns to recovery. Use **MAINT LOAD** for the current tools. MON A on that board remains retained legacy firmware and is unqualified. This is not a whole-board clone or an automatic updater.

The operator ZIP contains an unchanged copy of the released foundation kit under foundation/ and optional flash images under monitor/payload/. Follow MONITOR-MANUAL.md before admitting replacement of owner sectors. Run python verify_candidate.py after extraction; start the terminal with python foundation/tools/nf_console.py. No assembler is needed to use the prebuilt kit.

Acceptance retained images outside admitted targets, boot policy, owner RAM/ZP and SRAM data. The separately approved D rotation archived its old sector on the host; no F writes, C erases, power cuts, clock set, trim changes or RTC PF acknowledgement occurred. RTC/NTP collection was requalified with all prior samples and baselines retained. Precise receipts and limits are included.

Source checkpoint: 94ef0696dbaa3cb8d66f6355db480fba093b3d60. Source review: https://github.com/95westus/STR8N-F/pull/5

name: STR8N-F v0.3.0 - BASE1 / PR05 - g00000001
body:
## Start here

- **[Read the user manual](https://github.com/95westus/STR8N-F/blob/9da1990205278c64217af5fd630cf94b4d269f6a/docs/USER_MANUAL.md)** (also available below as STR8N-F-0.3.0-MANUAL.md).
- **[F.bin — exactly 4KB](https://github.com/95westus/STR8N-F/releases/download/v0.3.0/F.bin)** for B3:F only.
- **[Complete operator kit](https://github.com/95westus/STR8N-F/releases/download/v0.3.0/STR8N-F-BASE1-0.3.0.zip)** with WDC RAM migration programs, Python serial terminal and RAM tools.

The manual covers WDC migration, programmer installation, opaque-image installation/readback and saving an enabled bank as the default. These are additive downloads; the original ZIPs and firmware bytes remain unchanged.

---

# STR8N-F 0.3.0 â€” the 4KB foundation

> 4KB of firmware. One board. Up to four boot environments.

For WDC **W65C02SXB** (65C02) and **W65C816SXB** (65C816 emulation), with optional matching W65C02EDU or W65C816EDU add-on boards. BASE1 boot/recovery does not require EDU. [WDC board descriptions](https://wdc65xx.com/Single-Board-Computers).

Compatible, user-supplied images run one at a time on the same CPU,
approximately 32KB RAM on supported boards, and peripherals.
The kit supplies boot/recovery tools; applications and operating
environments are supplied separately.

STR8N-F supplies boot selection and recovery in **4096 bytes**, leaving
116 KiB of flash for owner images. Boot configuration and conservative
erase-attempt counts persist in the separate C/D journal. Rich OS status,
menus and device services belong to optional images.

F is **STR8N-F 0.3.0 g00000001 / BASE1 / PR05**. Its public ABI and exact
bytes remain frozen; no firmware rebuild accompanies this release.

## Downloads and use

- `STR8N-F-BOOT-4096.bin`: only B3:F000-FFFF. Under the standard linear
  128 KiB layout the offset is 1F000; confirm your programmer's mapping.
- `STR8N-F-BASE1-0.3.0.zip`: complete operator kit with five matching RAM
  tools, **Python Serial Console 0.1.0**, F-key transfers, verbose installation
  hosts, prebuilt engines, guides, manifests and hardware receipts.
- `STR8N-F-BASE1-0.3.0-source.zip`: corresponding source and build recipes.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: hashes for both ZIPs and the standalone F BIN.

The F BIN is not a whole-chip image. Installing F alone does not provision
occupied C/D. Follow [installation](https://github.com/95westus/STR8N-F/blob/v0.3.0/docs/INSTALLATION.md) for WDC migration,
programmer-installed-F provisioning or the supported existing-journal upgrade.
Back up original images, settings, history and owner RAM before helpers run.
Owner WDC firmware, private captures and per-board plans are not distributed.

The terminal needs Python 3.11+ with Tk and `pyserial==3.5`. See
[quick start](https://github.com/95westus/STR8N-F/blob/v0.3.0/docs/QUICK_START.md) and [terminal keys](https://github.com/95westus/STR8N-F/blob/v0.3.0/docs/SERIAL_CONSOLE.md).

## Evidence and boundaries

Reviewed 2512/65C02/FT245/Windows cases passed: reset/recovery, native terminal
keys/dialogs, Ctrl-C and BIN loading, CONFIG/opaque boot, WDC migration,
programmer-F provisioning and named chip-idle C/D recovery cases.
The unchanged rc1 operator kit's existing-SNBT upgrade also passed on
2609/65C816 emulation/FT245, retaining old records, images, boot settings and
owner RAM. See [status and receipts](https://github.com/95westus/STR8N-F/blob/v0.3.0/docs/RELEASE_STATUS.md).

This final package corrects docs/metadata/packaging and names the planned
optional monitor **Mona**. Firmware, terminal, migration hosts and engines
are unchanged from rc1. The final ZIP itself has not had another live trial;
the extracted WDC and programmer-F routes remain untested as package routes.
The manual original-capture precondition remains documented in
[rc1 findings](https://github.com/95westus/STR8N-F/blob/v0.3.0/docs/RC1_KNOWN_ISSUES.md). This is a scoped 0.3.0 release, not a
qualification of every board, adapter, layout or failure mode.

Normal recovery assumes F stays golden. Interrupted F installation,
electrical mid-pulse failures, native application-mode calls and ACIA physical
operation are not qualified. No hardware was accessed for final packaging.
No Mona image or expanded F ABI is included; see [Mona](https://github.com/95westus/STR8N-F/blob/v0.3.0/docs/MONA.md).

Frozen F SHA-256:
`8f4d35ac66730daa773515980983fcf442be3b1bdf1e523d3752ec3615657cc1`.

name: STR8N-F v0.2.0 — Boot & Recovery Toolkit
body:
STR8N-F is now the focused **Boot & Recovery Toolkit** for WDC banked 65C02 and 65C816 emulation-mode boards using USB/FT245.

Download **STR8N-F-v0.2.0.zip** for the operator kit. Extract it, run `python verify_package.py`, then read `START_HERE.md`. Download the separate **-source.zip** for the complete self-contained source and optional development modules.

Included in the operator kit:
- Exact 4096-byte b15 F sector at B3:F000-FFFF.
- Matching CONFIG, OPAQUE, DEMO and READBACK RAM tools.
- Optional compact BASE MON A/B component images.
- Quick start, image/entry/return contract, explicit installation destinations, paced OIP1 packet preparation, binary export protocol and SHA-256 manifests.

B0/B1/B2 are user-owned in the N/F profile. EDU, SPI SRAM, RTC and a full STR8-N installation are not required for F boot/recovery. Existing owner contents are preserved by choosing admitted targets; the kit performs no automatic installation.

The package version is 0.2.0. F remains **2.0proto b15 / PR04 / generation 8000000F**, SHA-256 `1a1db354d49d8a9a555be1100b74f3e4b0ed14d3156f3a333086853a845717b8`. Its bytes were not rebuilt or relabelled.

This is an **early toolkit release**, not stable 1.0 factory-migration acceptance. A general preserving factory-WDC migrator, owner-history import/repair and automatic live opaque host installer are not supplied. Raw L ends on transfer silence and has no declared length/transfer CRC. The physical support claim is USB; ACIA and native-816 applications are not physically qualified here. See `docs/RELEASE_STATUS.md` for the exact inherited evidence and limits.

The source package also retains optional VX1/ES1/MAINT/FLASH development. The SPI WORK message journal, WTOR, login/session policy, new maps, personality ports and BASIC/Forth selector remain planned.

Release validation checked extracted operator/source packages, component hashes/destinations, public-file membership and all 143 committed source blobs against the source ZIP. CI ran integrity jobs only; CPU-model jobs were skipped. No assembly rebuild, CPU simulation, board flashing or 2205 modification was performed for this release. No WDC firmware, owner backups, journals, SRAM or RTC/PF captures are distributed. The v0.1.0-preview.1 release remains unchanged.

name: STR8N-F v0.1.0-preview.1 — boot and opaque source preview
body:
STR8N-F is a separate, directly buildable tree focused on booting user images in B0, B1, B2 and B3 from the single B3:$F000-$FFFF bootstrap/recovery sector.

This is a **source preview**, retaining the b15 / PR04 firmware identity. It is not stable factory-onboarding acceptance.

Included:
- The unchanged 4096-byte b15 F image, matching CONFIG, opaque sector installer and RAM demo.
- Operator keystrokes, installation boundaries, OIP1 protocol, offline packet preparation and direct WDC build instructions.
- Source provenance, firmware SHA-256 baselines, vendored BSD CPU models and 26 passing CPU/NOR test groups.
- A deterministic source/candidate ZIP, per-file manifest and external SHA-256 checksum.

Validation: independent direct-source builds match all four BIN baselines; both CPU models pass; the extracted package rebuilds without parent-tree inputs; committed Git blobs produce the same ZIP as the working tree. The CONFIG predecessor differs only in its same-length generic banner. No physical board was flashed for this extraction.

Before a stable release: general factory WDC backup/F-only migration, explicit wear-history provisioning/import, a live opaque host transfer workflow and final hardware/power-transition/ACIA acceptance. See docs/RELEASE_STATUS.md. MON A/B, extensions, maintenance, EDU/SRAM and BASIC/Forth application bundles remain separate optional stages.

No original WDC firmware, owner backups, personal wear counts, SRAM or RTC/PF captures are distributed.
